title: StudyLoop
summary: StudyLoop is a local-first desktop application built with Go, Wails, and Vue 3 that guides learners through a structured study workflow using a persistent SQLite study queue, FSRS spaced repetition, and local RAG capabilities.
highlights: Implements a guided learning workflow driven by a persistent SQLite study queue with deterministic priority ordering.
Integrates FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler) for long-term flashcard retention and review session management.
Uses ONNX Runtime and sqlite-vec (vec0) for local INT8 embedding generation and vector search in offline RAG pipelines.
Built with a Go backend desktop shell using Wails v2 and a Vue 3 multi-page frontend.
Supports dual-tier LLM configurations (Fast and Heavy models) with OS keyring API key storage for AI explanations and quiz generation.

title: Voice Agent Platform
summary: Modular voice agent system built with Python, FastAPI, PydanticAI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and WebSockets for real-time speech pipelines and RAG workflows.
highlights: Spearheaded a modular voice-agent architecture using interchangeable adapters for Transport, STT, LLM, TTS, and Embedding providers.
Integrated a real-time speech pipeline connecting speech recognition, language models, streaming generation, and TTS synthesis.
Constructed domain-specific conversational agents supporting retrieval-augmented generation and tool-calling workflows.
Added telemetry, latency instrumentation, fallback handling, and turn-level observability.

title: WalletOS
summary: API-first wallet management platform for wallet operations, transaction history, tenant-based auth, and audit logging built in an Nx monorepo.
highlights: Contributed to an API-first wallet management platform for wallet operations, transaction history, and audit logging.
Maintained services within an Nx monorepo containing an Express API, customer web application, and administrative dashboard.
Engineered features involving tenant-based authentication, scoped API keys, session tokens, and REST APIs.
Enforced immutable transaction workflows, idempotent write operations, and audit logging.

title: Forge CLI
summary: Windows CLI written in Go that automates project initialization from reusable templates by orchestrating Git, Python, uv, and npm.
highlights: Automates project initialization from reusable templates by orchestrating ecosystem tools such as Git, Python, uv, and npm.
Introduced a template-driven workflow supporting project-local and global templates for consistent project setup.
Designed predictable command execution that runs native development tools rather than generating project scaffolding.
Published the tool through GitHub Releases with Windows-friendly installation and distribution.

title: Mind Palace Study Tool
summary: AI-assisted study application utilizing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and local vector databases with Python, Streamlit, and LangChain.
highlights: Developed an AI-assisted study application exploring retrieval-augmented generation and adaptive learning workflows.
Integrated semantic retrieval using local vector databases.
Served as the structural foundation for the later Study Workflow System.

title: FocusPlay
summary: Desktop productivity application combining a Pomodoro timer with an integrated music player, built using Go and Wails.
highlights: Assembled a desktop productivity application combining a Pomodoro timer with an integrated music player.
Targeted distraction reduction and personal focus workflows.
Crafted a lightweight cross-platform desktop application using Go and Wails.
